journeys.name: Discovery to Pricing to Package Comparison
journeys.transition_contract: Each clear current intent replaces the active answer objective while compatible trusted grade/subject context remains reusable.

journeys.name: Discovery to Pricing to Price Objection to Trial
journeys.transition_contract: Price objection may interrupt pricing; explicit trial request then becomes the active conversion objective without losing compatible student context.

journeys.name: Trial Details to Explicit Trial Start to Registration Intake
journeys.transition_contract: Information-only trial inquiry remains non-action; explicit trial-start wording transitions to intake; registration collects only the smallest missing validated field.

journeys.name: Registration to Availability to Schedule Request
journeys.transition_contract: Scheduling questions may interrupt registration intake while preserving trusted context; availability inquiry and booking request remain distinct states.

journeys.name: Availability to Requested Slot to Safe Alternative
journeys.transition_contract: Requested slot remains preference/pending until authoritative live scheduling confirms it; alternatives remain proposals, not bookings.

journeys.name: Known Context to Single-Field Correction
journeys.transition_contract: Current explicit correction has higher trust than the prior value for that field only; compatible trusted fields remain unchanged.

journeys.name: Child or Student Context Switch
journeys.transition_contract: A clear switch to another child/student creates a new student-scoped context; only safe parent-scoped context may carry forward.

journeys.name: Sales Journey to Human Handoff
journeys.transition_contract: Explicit human request suspends the active sales objective and becomes the active support ownership path.

journeys.name: Sales Journey to Technical Support or Complaint Interruption
journeys.transition_contract: Support/complaint overrides sales; prior sales context may be suspended for safe later reuse but cannot drive the current answer.

journeys.name: Policy Question Inside Active Sales Journey
journeys.transition_contract: Policy inquiry temporarily replaces the answer objective without mutating the underlying sales action state; prior context resumes only on a new customer signal.

journeys.name: Long Conversation to Stale-Context Override
journeys.transition_contract: A new clear intent after a long journey becomes authoritative for the current turn even when historical sales state is richer.

journeys.name: Multilingual Continuity and Deliberate Language Switch
journeys.transition_contract: Language choice affects response language, not semantic-state ownership; explicit current-language signal controls the next response language.
